heard: Peniel was the father of Jedor, Izzer the father of Hushab, sons of Hur the firstborn of Ephrathah the father of Bethlehem. Jedor in the hill country, a name in the line of Judah A place in the ancient land where the genealogies are drawn Med's wife bore Jerusalem The father of Jedor Son of Bethiah, Pharaoh's daughter.
